name: Francis Taylor
source:
Francis was Edward’s classmate and roommate from boarding school. They lost contact after Edward left school, but have reunited upon Francis’s return to London. 

Francis is kind and considerate to all, but is also rather meek and indecisive.

Currently he works as a secretary while reading and studying in his spare time to achieve his dream.

Francis has an unfortunate tendency to get caught up in strange cases, and thus in desperate need of a detective—even an amateur one like Edward.

[From [url=http://studiopie.cafe24.com/eng/dear_edward] Official Website[/url]]
